verdict.rationale: Together's first-party docs describe Dedicated Model Inference: serving a model on reserved hardware, with no hard rate limits, unlike the shared serverless pool. Deployment is shown via `tg beta endpoints deploy`, and autoscaling uses configurable min/max replica bounds driven by a metric you choose. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that dedicated endpoints and their autoscaling work as described (the deploy CLI is also marked beta).
